concept: An equestrian estate at the desert edge; estate tour and enquiry.

shots.title: Hero
shots.section: Home hero, full screen behind the headline
shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of a long low villa with stables and paddocks in Al Marmoom at the desert edge. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: warm country-estate photography, 35mm; colour palette of sand, chestnut, olive, white. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Hero for phones
shots.prompt: Vertical architectural photograph looking up along a long low villa with stables and paddocks in Al Marmoom at the desert edge, facade lines converging into a clear sky, sunlight catching the main materials, strong graphic composition. shots.title: Interiors
shots.camera: Interior, 24mm, eye level, one window light
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Interior photographs inside a long low villa with stables and paddocks, finished in rustic luxury with leather, oak and stone, staged and uncluttered, one soft daylight, nobody present. Top-left: the main living room with its view. Top-right: the kitchen and dining area. Bottom-left: the principal bedroom. Bottom-right: the principal bathroom. Overall look: warm country-estate photography, 35mm; colour palette of sand, chestnut, olive, white. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
